## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

MainActivity — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

The ambient transitions bound in `onCreate` via `ambientBinder.bind`
(`onEnterAmbient` / `onExitAmbient`) — observed

## Today

`MainActivity.onCreate` binds `ambientBinder` with an `onEnterAmbient`
lambda that only calls `alwaysOnDisplayController.enterPowerSave()`,
and an `onExitAmbient` lambda that only calls
`alwaysOnDisplayController.exitPowerSave()`. Neither lambda touches
`ExerciseSessionManager`. `ExerciseSessionManager.onInteractivityChanged`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/session/ExerciseSessionManager.kt)
reconfigures the running session's data delivery mode — batched or
continuous — but is called only from
`ExerciseSessionManagerTest.kt`; no production code calls it.
`ExerciseSessionManager` is already provided as a `@Singleton` by
`SensorModule` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/di/SensorModule.kt),
the same way `AmbientBinder` and `SensorPermissionManager` are already
injected into `MainActivity`, so it is reachable from the activity
without any new wiring beyond an `@Inject` field.

## Expected

Entering ambient mode (`onEnterAmbient`) calls
`exerciseSessionManager.onInteractivityChanged(false)`, and exiting
ambient mode (`onExitAmbient`) calls
`exerciseSessionManager.onInteractivityChanged(true)`, alongside the
existing `alwaysOnDisplayController` calls.
